additional_reconciled_findings.C4V: On the 1.024-day B01 fixed-water-table persistence test, the minimum transferred lower-zone member persistently crossing both R2 and FMC moved to R8.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4W: The B01 one-day spurious reversal mechanism was characterized without authorizing closure retuning.

additional_reconciled_findings.C4Y: The first response-blind dynamic prescribed-head transfer produced no representation adjudication because the frozen R2 comparator failed closed under the inherited RS1 local fallback allowance before a complete trajectory existed. C4Y remains closed and is not retuned.
additional_reconciled_findings.C4Z: Fresh blind B01 dynamic prescribed-head validation yields a formal R2-relative minimum R3 for both frozen vectors, but R2 itself misses reversal sequences in 3/4 histories. The lower-zone ladder improves sharply through R8 and lower-zone placement outperforms uniform placement at dimensions 4 and 8.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5A: Matched B14 dynamic-head transfer has no reduced R2-relative GW frontier under the frozen vector. Every lower-zone member fails only pooled absolute mean signed bottom-flux error; R5-R16 plateau on that blocker while placement advantage persists.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5B: Timestep convergence and added lower-zone state above the boundary cell are negligible relative to the C5A residual. Error is confined to prescribed-head phases. BOUNDARY_FACE is strongly sensitive but substantially worse. The unresolved axis is bottom-adjacent spatial thickness under CURRENT_LAYER_FACE.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5C: The B14 dynamic prescribed-head R16/R32/R64 Richards sequence is not yet spatially asymptotic. LARE bottom-cell refinement strongly reduces error relative to R64, but no closure-floor claim is valid until Reference spatial authority is extended.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5D: R128 and R256 qualify and adjacent-grid bottom-flux RMSE decreases twice after R64, but only weakly. Observed orders near 0.06-0.11 do not establish an asymptotic Reference regime.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5E: R512 and R1024 qualify. Adjacent-grid RMSE decreases strongly and descriptive order strengthens to about 0.84, but temporal transaction error remains unreconciled; no continuum Reference is yet admitted.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5F: At R1024, temporal refinement progresses from T1-T2 RMSE ~0.00975 cm/d to T2-T4 ~0.00610. The T4 temporal shift is ~29% of the matched T2 R512-R1024 spatial gap. Spatial gap changes ~9.3% between T1 and T2, so space-time interaction is non-negligible.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5G: The complete R512/R1024 x T1/T2/T4 matrix shows decreasing temporal shifts at both resolutions but a spatial gap that increases from 0.01928 to 0.02107 to 0.02233 cm/d as time is refined. Temporal T2-T4 shifts are subdominant but non-negligible.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5H: At T8, temporal errors shrink with observed order ~0.79-0.84 and are only ~12-15% of the R512-R1024 spatial gap, but that spatial gap still increases to 0.02303 cm/d. One final matched temporal refinement is required before R2048.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5I: At T16 the R512-R1024 spatial bottom-flux RMSE still increases to ~0.02340 cm/d while T8-T16 temporal shifts fall to ~0.00147/0.00180 cm/d (6.3/7.7% of the spatial gap). Temporal error is subdominant; brute-force T32/R2048 is stopped pending prescribed-head boundary-discretization diagnosis.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5J: The prescribed-head spatial gap is strongly boundary-discretization-sensitive. Doubling the half-cell distance worsens the gap by ~31%; arithmetic center-boundary K reduces it only ~2.6%; interaction is ~30% of the larger main effect. No counterfactual is admitted.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5K: On byte-identical C5I states, post-step K and theory-derived arithmetic/integrated/exact-steady half-cell operators all increase the R512-R1024 grid gap; integrated and exact-steady are nearly identical. Pre-step K lag is smaller than the nonlinear spatial correction. No dynamic boundary counterfactual is authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5L: With unchanged G0K0 Reference at T16, R1024-R2048 bottom-flux RMSE falls to ~0.00742 cm/d from ~0.02340 for R512-R1024 (ratio ~0.317, descriptive order ~1.66). Spatial refinement is clearly progressing, but R2048 is not admitted as continuum truth and its temporal error is not independently qualified.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5M: No universal minimum layer count survives cross-material/boundary/horizon reconciliation. Lower-zone placement is the replicated structural finding; purpose and horizon alter required state. C5A remains formally negative under its frozen comparator but is not portable after the Reference audit.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5N: Fresh blind B14 dynamic-head evidence with qualified R512/R1024/R2048 T16 and R2048 T8 controls finds no reduced R3-R12 high-resolution comparator frontier. Placement R4>U4 and R8>U8 replicates, but R5-R16 response plateaus. State count alone therefore does not rescue BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE; inter-layer closure becomes the next representation axis.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5O: C5N's R5-R16 plateau cannot uniquely identify closure failure because all members retain the same 10-cm bottom layer; extra states were added higher in the profile. Together with C5C bottom-refinement sensitivity and replicated R4/U4, R8/U8 placement effects, the next clean discriminator is fixed-dimension bottom-focused repartitioning under unchanged CURRENT_LAYER_FACE before opening a new closure implementation.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5P: Fresh fixed-dimension B14 dynamic-head evidence shows a causal bottom-adjacent placement effect: D8 B10->B5->B2P5 improves componentwise on groundwater and profile views, but no focused member reaches the R1024 high-resolution comparator. D4 overconcentration at B2P5 adds sign/reversal timing errors, demonstrating that boundary support and broader vertical memory must be balanced.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5Q: Read-only identifiability reconciliation required one final D12 shared-bottom-support breadth discriminator before any distinct closure implementation.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5R: Fresh D12 versus D8 comparison at identical B2P5 bottom support finds groundwater response numerically indistinguishable despite four additional vertically distributed states. Bottom placement remains active, but additional memory breadth is inactive; the residual is now strongly identified with propagation/inter-layer closure.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5S: After C5R isolates propagation as the remaining representation limit, read-only closure reconciliation rejects reopening scalar/current-state gradient tuning and identifies a zero-parameter Darcian steady-equivalent nonlinear two-point flux (DSE2P) as the first structurally distinct closure ready for an offline frozen-state mechanism discriminator. A storage-consistent algebraic subgrid-profile closure remains conceptually admissible but requires more theory before implementation.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5T: Logging-only frozen-state instrumentation preserves C5R exactly, but the preregistered steady-integral DSE2P route fails its mandatory numerical qualification at the first 70-cm interface for 1,891 states. No free-running DSE2P test or post-response retuning is authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5V: Read-only SCAFP derivation shows that layer-integrated storage plus Darcy-Buckingham and exact conservation does not uniquely determine transient within-layer structure. A conservative zero-fit algebraic family exists, but an additional subgrid tendency/profile principle is scientifically required. P0 uniform storage tendency is the most conservation-aligned candidate, not an authority-mandated choice.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5W: P0 uniform storage tendency was selected prospectively as the minimum-additional-structure SCAFP hypothesis and failed response-free admissibility qualification: local uniqueness is conditional, but 264/405 local cases and all 28 full-column synthetic cases fail the frozen existence/branch contract. No hydrological P0 test is authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5X: After prospective P0 failure, choosing quadratic-head or transformed-potential storage-only reconstructions would remain an unselected ansatz choice. C4K's bounded ambiguity result is not universal memoryless sufficiency; state sufficiency is therefore reopened read-only.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5Y: The centered first water-content moment M_i=∫(z-zc)theta dz is the smallest additional scalar shape state with an exact balance from continuity. A conservation-native mixed quadratic/cubic theta hierarchy closes the global degree count for any selected enriched-layer subset, but existence/uniqueness/admissibility remain unqualified.
additional_reconciled_findings.C5Z: Response-free mathematical qualification finds one stable numerical branch and full hydraulic/state consistency in all 168 cases, but 14 cases violate the prospectively frozen upper theta/Se admissibility domain. The all-layer moment-enriched cubic-theta reconstruction is therefore stopped without retuning.
additional_reconciled_findings.CoRichards_Q1: R3-R12 same-partition conventional Richards provide no dynamically qualified reduced common cohort under strict DYN0A authority; R16 alone restores dynamic viability. Q2 is not authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.cross_axis_gap: C4V, C4X and C4Z cover B01/fixed, B14/fixed and B01/dynamic. The missing B14/dynamic cell is the direct test of material-by-boundary interaction in the current representation hypothesis.
additional_reconciled_findings.interaction_matrix: The B01/B14 x fixed/dynamic matrix is now complete. Material and lower-boundary semantics interact; neither a universal state count nor boundary-only explanation is supported.
additional_reconciled_findings.value_boundary: C4Q is exposed development evidence. R12 retains 12/16 water states, so hydrological frontier success does not establish computational value.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6A: Response-free derivation shows that explicit algebraic interface head/flux unknowns guarantee conservation but do not supply missing transient subgrid information. Lowest-order linear hybridization condenses to a standard two-point Darcy operator; exact steady nonlinear half-cells condense to DSE2P; affine within-layer flux is P0. A genuinely new family therefore requires a new physically justified transient subgrid state or closure principle.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6B: The centered first water-content moment is retained, but the failed cubic-theta map is not reopened. BEMR represents the frozen bounded effective-saturation interval through a logistic entropy-dual variable and uses the minimum four-dimensional polynomial dual space required by the existing S/M plus hydraulic degree count. The family is selected response-free and must be qualified on the unchanged C5Z synthetic domain before any hydrological response.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6C: BEMR passes response-free mathematical qualification on all 168 unchanged C5Z B14 state/moment cases and all 840 fixed starts. Strict moment realizability, convergence, single branch, bounded Se, hydraulic continuity, state recovery and quadrature consistency all pass. This establishes the algebraic map, not hydrological fidelity.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6D: On 2,304 immutable C5R moving states, directly projected S/M plus the C6C-qualified BEMR map passes all numerical gates and prospectively supports boundary-extension qualification: pooled primary RMSE 0.008709->0.006075 cm/d, mean-absolute interface/history signed bias 0.001138->0.000190 cm/d and sign mismatches 229->190, with RMSE improved at each primary face. However max absolute error worsens 0.1027->0.1842 cm/d due a preserved R02 phase-reversal outlier; BEMR is not uniformly superior.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6E: Response-free prescribed-flux qualification is negative. All 126 S/M targets are realizable and all 630 starts report convergence, but only 121/126 cases satisfy the frozen unique-branch, hydraulic-continuity and state-recovery contract. Five cases exhibit start-dependent near-upper-bound residual attractors despite a qualified branch existing from other starts. No post-result start selection, regularization, continuation, bound relaxation or free-running BEMR is authorized.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6F: Two conserved half-layer inventories have exact local balances and direct box realizability, but the natural Darcy implementation is exactly a fixed 2N finite-volume refinement. Any physically distinct internal q_mid requires a new closure not determined by conservation. C6F therefore closes without D24/free-running response.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6G: A finite independent interface-local bulk-water inventory requires positive spatial support; non-overlap makes it an ordinary control volume/refinement, overlap makes it a redundant weighted moment with unresolved flux moment, and zero-thickness finite storage would be new interface physics.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6H: Moving control volumes preserve mass exactly in ALE relative-flux form, but Richards does not determine mesh velocity. Algebraic monitor-based motion is numerical adaptation without new hydrological memory; retained boundary positions add nearly N extra states plus an unprovided motion law. Generic moving geometry is therefore not selected as the next physical Layer-ROM family.
additional_reconciled_findings.C6I: The frozen Richards retention and Darcy mobility define a capillary/gravitational energy-dissipation structure. Given feasible S/M, strict capillary-energy convexity selects a unique bounded local quasi-equilibrium profile that is affine in suction in the interior. Projecting the Onsager dissipation principle onto this moment manifold defines a distinct parameter-free dynamic ROM family (FEMO), without reopening the C6E BEMR static root.

fixed_partition_LARE: Conservative standard LARE is physically coherent and resolution-convergent in the bounded DYN0A laboratory.
Low-dimensional fixed partitions are not broadly qualified; critical dynamic storage error decreases strongly with added states and approaches the fine control only at high dimension.
Gradient reconstruction, not conductivity localization, is the dominant bounded internal-flux error mechanism.
C4K did not establish a need for extra history state in the tested BC2 current-state space.
C4L, C4M, C4N and C4O did not establish a transferable zero-fit scalar internal-gradient correction across width and regime.
Further scalar tuning of the same fixed-partition closure is therefore not authorized by current evidence.
purpose_and_value: F-ROMV2 does not require numerical equivalence to fine Richards for a deliberately reduced model.
Application acceptance remains purpose-dependent and has not been adjudicated for this representation boundary.
No speed or production-ROM claim is authorized.
same_partition_CoRichards: R3 was already dynamically blocked under frozen strict Reference numerical authority.
Q1 extended the same comparator to R4, R5, R6, R8 and R12 and found zero qualified non-equilibrium dynamic histories at every reduced dimension through 16 temporal substeps.
R16 exactly reproduces the fine Reference status map and qualifies all seven expected physically in-domain dynamic histories.
Reduced same-partition CoRichards is therefore unavailable as a dynamic equal-dimension comparator in this bounded laboratory under current authority.
This numerical availability result does not imply hydrological superiority of LARE.

retained_controls: Fine Reference Richards remains scientific reference.
R16 remains no-spatial-reduction control, not a ROM.
Standard LARE resolution ladder remains a bounded state-count versus fidelity reference.
CoRichards R3-R12 blocked results remain numerical-availability evidence only.
